spec.name: A

annotations.resolution: Container OOMKilled (137) OR in-process abort (SIGABRT/exit 134 - e.g. Node.js 'JavaScript heap out of memory' hit BELOW the cgroup limit). kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} describe pod {{ $labels.pod }} | grep -A5 'Last State'; kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} logs {{ $labels.pod }} --previous | tail -40; raise memory / --max-old-space-size , or chase the leak.
